description: Token format for the stroke code: a suspected stroke patient as the paramedics find them, and what the hospital's tests will find

lvo_early._comment: Thrombolysis, then transfer for clot retrieval (drip and ship)

lysis_only._comment: Thrombolysis; no occlusion: the suite is stood down

mimic._comment: Low glucose: treated on the road, no stroke code, no suite hold

haemorrhage._comment: Bleed on CT: no reperfusion, the suite is stood down

lysis_bp_treated._comment: Blood pressure 200/105 lowered to 175/95, then thrombolysis; no occlusion

late_lvo._comment: Woke with symptoms 7 hours ago: no thrombolysis, clot retrieval only

anticoagulated._comment: On warfarin, INR 2.6, no occlusion: no reperfusion, the suite is stood down

tia._comment: Symptoms resolved by arrival: stroke excluded at the door, the suite is stood down

notes: tokenId, version, notAfter, currentPlace, workflow_start_time are auto-populated
Without -variant, patient n presents with caseMix[(n - 1) mod its length]: ten suspected strokes, of which
the ambulance alerts nine (the mimic is not a stroke code). Of those nine, three go on to clot retrieval and six
stand the held angiography suite down: the stand-down process (v002) releases each of those six holds.
The clinical values are simplified for the demonstration; they are not clinical guidance.
